description: Fetch the full MARC record for one bib id in the National Parliamentary Library of Georgia catalogue (the `bib_id` nplg_search returns, e.g. "b4972685"). Returns the leader, control fields and every data field with its indicators and subfields kept separate — so the 041 language codes and the parallel Georgian/English 245 stay machine-readable rather than flattened into one string.

bib_id.description: Sierra bib id as returned by nplg_search, e.g. "b4972685". The leading "b" is optional.

name: nplg_record_marc
title: Nplg Record Marc
